name: Amanita August
source:
You run a tiny shop in the kingdom of Amanita, which has been attacked by an evil demon king and his army. So your job as a humble shopkeeper is to ensure that the chosen hero is well-prepared for her quest! Provide her with weapons, clothing, medical supplies, and maybe even friendship?

[From [url=https://yami-savvy.itch.io/amanita-august]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在鹅膏菌王国经营一家小商店，该商店遭到邪恶恶魔王和他的军队的攻击。因此，作为一名谦虚的店主，你的工作就是确保所选英雄为她的任务做好充分准备！为她提供武器、衣服、医疗用品，甚至友谊？

[来自[url=https://yami-savvy.itch.io/amanita-august]itch.io[/url]]
